mods.comment: KEEP DISABLED. This NOPs the sceKernelUsleep in FrameLimiter_Update (sub_401B20). That limiter IS the engine's 60 FPS cap: game logic advances on a fixed 60 Hz timestep (see FrameLimiter_Update interval and the per-frame tick in GameFrameLoop), so removing it lets the loop run as fast as the machine allows and game speed scales with FPS (e.g. 120 FPS = 2x speed). Disabled so the 60 FPS cap stays in force; the 3D present is decoupled separately by the 'Uncap 3D Frame Present' mod.

memory.comment: Disable Frame Limiter: NOPs the sceKernelUsleep in FrameLimiter_Update (sub_401B20). The engine stops sleeping toward the 60 FPS deadline; frame delta-time becomes the real elapsed time (uncapped).

mods.name: Uncap framerate (Use with 60FPS patch, increases gamespeed!)

memory.comment: Decouple 3D present from vblank: NOPs the sceKernelWaitEqueue in GraphicsDevice_SubmitFlipAndWait (sub_224960). The engine submits a sceVideoOutSubmitFlip every frame and then BLOCKS one vblank waiting for that flip's completion event. In heavy 3D (dungeon/combat) render+submit just exceeds one 60Hz interval, so the block lands two vblanks later -> a hard 30 FPS lock, while light 2D menus stay 60. Removing the wait lets the flip queue (bounded by flipPendingNum<3 spin) pace frames instead of the vblank event.
